parameters.query: SELECT t.code, t.name, t.sport, t.status, t.visibility, DATE_FORMAT(t.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS start_date, t.area, t.city, t.logo_key, t.max_teams, t.entry_fee, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_entries e WHERE e.tournament_id = t.id AND e.status = 'APPROVED') AS approved_teams, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_entries e WHERE e.tournament_id = t.id AND e.status = 'PENDING') AS pending_teams, 'ORGANIZER' AS role, NULL AS team_name, NULL AS entry_status, 0 AS sort_group, t.created_at AS sort_at FROM tournaments t JOIN app_users u ON u.id = t.organizer_user_id WHERE u.phone = $1 UNION ALL SELECT t.code, t.name, t.sport, t.status, t.visibility, DATE_FORMAT(t.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), t.area, t.city, t.logo_key, t.max_teams, t.entry_fee, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_entries x WHERE x.tournament_id = t.id AND x.status = 'APPROVED'), 0, IF(ep.id IS NOT NULL, 'PLAYER', 'TEAM'), tm.name, e.status, 1, t.start_date FROM tournament_entries e JOIN tournaments t ON t.id = e.tournament_id JOIN teams tm ON tm.id = e.team_id JOIN app_users u ON u.phone = $1 LEFT JOIN tournament_entry_players ep ON ep.entry_id = e.id AND ep.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN team_members mm ON mm.team_id = e.team_id AND mm.user_id = u.id AND mm.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mm.role IN ('COACH', 'CAPTAIN', 'VICE_CAPTAIN') WHERE e.status IN ('PENDING', 'WAITLISTED', 'APPROVED') AND (ep.id IS NOT NULL OR mm.id IS NOT NULL) AND t.organizer_user_id <> u.id ORDER BY sort_group, sort_at DESC
